text:
```yaml
name: Remote Access Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - "1.85.0"
          - stable
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache: true
          cache-workspaces: |
            rust/foxglove
            rust/foxglove-websocket
            rust/foxglove-ros
            rust/foxglove-ros2
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys-build
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys-build-tools
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys-build-tools-c
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys-build-tools-cxx
            rust/foxglove-ros2-ffi-sys-build-tools-cxx-abi
```
